Call surface

.dr-call · __top · __who · __name · __time · __side · __side--empty · __stage · __avatar · __bar · components/call.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

9:41
Andriy M. Call duration 02:14
  1. 1.dr-callThe ground: --bg-night, #1A1A1A, the same value as the primary ink under the name of the role it plays here.
  2. 2.dr-call__topThe top row on a 12 gap: minimise on the left, the person in the middle, the side column on the right.
  3. 3.dr-call__nameWho is on the line: the 22 display step, page-coloured ink at 15.99:1.
  4. 4.dr-call__timeThe duration at 15, regular, in --text-on-night-muted, 11.54:1, with a screen-reader prefix Call duration.
  5. 5.dr-call__sideThe side actions, 44 call controls stacked on a 12 gap.
  6. 6.dr-call__avatarThe portrait disc, 176, on --bg-night-raised #2E2E2E, 1.28:1 against the ground.
  7. 7.dr-call__barThe control pill on --bg-night-raised: four 44 call controls on a 14 gap inside 8 of padding, one of them red.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Call surface.

States

No state of its own: the surface is a ground and a layout. Every control on it is a call control or a button, and carries their states.

When to use

The call surface is the product's one dark surface and the only screen the platform, rather than the product, owns. It is not a second theme and not a dark mode: a call is a full-screen takeover that has to recede, the way CallKit, FaceTime, WhatsApp and Telegram all do whatever the app's theme is. --bg-page stays the ground on every other screen. It stands on five screens: call, call-aerial and call-inspection (the client calls the operator, from tracking), call-client (the operator calls the client, from job-checklist) and call-support (the support agent, from contact-support).

The surface carries its own ink pair. --text-muted is barred here at 2.42:1, a real WCAG 1.4.3 failure; the dimmer ink is --text-on-night-muted at 11.54:1. There is no green at all, and the red fill goes only to End call, the one destructive control. The controls carry no visible words, so each name is in aria-label as verb and object: End call, not Hang up and not Cancel.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The night pair · § Destructive fill · § Call control · inventory.md § 1 (Call surface, End call, Call control) · microcopy.md § call, call-support, call-client

Rule and anti-rule

Do

The whole screen for the length of a voice call: night controls on the night ground, one red disc to end it, nothing green.

Don’t

Order #DR-4821 Operator on the way Contact operator

The night ground used as a dark card inside an ordinary screen, with a green button on it. The surface exists only for a call in progress. Order status belongs on an order card on the page ground, and reaching the operator goes through a sheet that offers the call.
